author: NickAtNight
quote: When Rockstar said they were becoming a more progressive company THEY MEANT IT! Absolutely ashamed to even call this a Grandd Theft Auto when committing crimes and killing characters is a “permanent choice” almost feels frowned upon in the game. Certain people are excluded from being killed, no edgy or satire which makes the characters / story very bland and forgettable. Jason is an absolute bot….. the first time Rockstar has created a protagonist that you don’t really understand what they stand for as a character besides being a simp. This game has great graphics & the mechanics are ok. Hopefully Rockstar learns their lesson & actually deliver on their titles names instead of producing woke garbage.
